title: Logistics: Progression
summary: Upgrade Logistics in stable steps without skipping the safety layer.

blocks.title: Upgrade Path
blocks.body: Progress from sorted storage into loadouts, route manifests, remote requests, and recurring stock checks. Expand only when labels and access still make sense.

blocks.title: Do Not Skip The Middle
blocks.body: The middle step is usually boring because it is the safety layer: storage, markers, meters, counters, backups, or notes. Build that layer before raising the risk.

blocks.title: Ready For More
blocks.body: You are ready to push Logistics further when the current loop feels repeatable, the failure signs are familiar, and the next upgrade has a clear purpose.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
